A few things

Good to know.

Can I use one plan with friends?

Yes. Every plan has a shareable link, so one person can make the plan and everyone can use it.

Will Boplo work in every city?

We are launching city by city so the recommendations can stay specific. Join the waitlist and tell us where you want Boplo first.

What if the weather changes?

Each plan includes a backup move. Future live plans will account for the weather on the day, too.
